instruction: Restore the left-side slides panel in LibreOffice Impress to show the slide thumbnails.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(5); pyautogui.press('esc'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('f10'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('right', presses=2, interval=0.1); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('down', presses=11, interval=0.1); pyautogui.press('enter')

metadata.explanation: This task requires the user to restore the left slides panel in LibreOffice Impress that was hidden via the View menu. The evaluator checks if 'Slides View' document-frame is present in the accessibility tree. The metric function uses the same logic as the original check_left_panel but is renamed with a unique hash to avoid conflicts.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts accessibility tree containing UI panel information
Metric logic correctly searches for document-frame element with name 'Slides View'
Expected value 'Slides View' is semantically correct for LibreOffice Impress slides panel
Metric correctly handles expected parameter as rules dictionary (expected.get('panel_name')) per framework requirements
Complete instruction coverage: evaluator verifies panel visibility as required
Proper edge case handling with try-except for XML parsing errors
Correct binary scoring (1.0 for visible, 0.0 for hidden)
